g.text: OpenAlex arXiv-linked Mathematics · frozen metadata, 16 September 2026
Both definitions use the same complete paired bylines. Each key is counted once per calendar year.
P/A is mean fractional paper credit; it is not mean full-count coauthored papers or validated person productivity.
Brown: P / unambiguously linked papers. Blue also counts IDs with ambiguous version links in its denominator.
This is byline completeness within the queried OpenAlex frame, not coverage of all arXiv mathematics.
Scope: primary OpenAlex field Mathematics; indexed in arXiv; queried publication years 2010–2026.
Unique arXiv ID dates 2010–2025; ambiguous links and unusable paired bylines excluded.
Name keys and resolved IDs can both split or combine people. No causal effect of AI is established.
